name: 壁砺™ 166C — Biren Technology official product page
notes: Biren publishes only form factor, power (300W for 166C, 550W 166M, 600W 166L) and the qualitative claim that compute and memory double vs the prior generation. No capacity or bandwidth figure exists on any vendor page. Widely circulated '128 GB HBM' numbers trace to Chinese aggregators and are not vendor data, so both fields are null.
